# Treasure AI - llms.txt

## About
Treasure AI is the Agentic Experience Platform built for brands who believe that AI, harnessed by human warmth and creativity, transforms how companies acquire, retain, and grow their most valuable customers 24/7. Treasure AI helps you transition from manually managing your existing SaaS software stack, towards running autonomous ROI-driving AI agents — all powered by layers of integrated customer knowledge.

Website: https://www.treasure.ai

## Key Pages

### Product & Solutions
- Customer Data Platform: https://www.treasure.ai/cdp
- Product Overview: https://www.treasure.ai/product
- Solutions: https://www.treasure.ai/solutions
- Integrations: https://www.treasure.ai/integrations

### Resources
- Blog: https://www.treasure.ai/blog
- Documentation: https://docs.treasure.ai
- Case Studies: https://www.treasure.ai/customers
- Resource Library: https://www.treasure.ai/resources

### Company
- About Us: https://www.treasure.ai/about
- Careers: https://www.treasure.ai/careers
- Contact: https://www.treasure.ai/contact

## Sitemap
https://www.treasure.ai/sitemap.xml

## Content Guidelines
- Focus: AI agents, agentic experience platforms, autonomous customer engagement, enterprise customer data platforms, data unification, personalization, analytics
- Industries: Retail, e-commerce, media, entertainment, gaming, financial services
- Target Audience: Data engineers, marketing technologists, CDOs, CMOs, data analysts

## Technical Stack
- CMS: HubSpot CMS Hub
- Forms: Marketo with Clearbit enrichment
- Analytics: Google Analytics 4, Treasure Data Studio
- Cookie Consent: OneTrust

## Contact
- Support: https://www.treasure.ai/support
- Sales: https://www.treasure.ai/contact-sales

---
